You need to set habits for yourself (and thus them) as early as possible. Make sure you schedule plenty of time out of the house (gym, overtime, friends, etc.), so you don't get on their nerves or they on yours. Don't fall into the trap of eating every meal together. I'd suggest eating one meal a week as a "family meal" - Saturday or Sunday lunch would work best. Don't eat with them in the evening if possible, and ideally don't be around much in the evening - eat out, watch TV or play games in your room, etc.; this is because people are more likely to have arguments and fight in the evening, and you want to avoid that (either you arguing, or getting caught up in their arguments). Don't drink at home under any circumstances - say it prevents you from sleeping - and don't come home drunk. Go to bed early, get up early, and use the facilities quietly. Set minimal chores and do them effectively and without complaint.

Above all, don't take sides if they argue. Get out of the room and preferably out of the house.
